units.source_text: 同时，源氏内大臣升任为太政大臣，右大将升任为内大臣。

en.t: At the same time, Minister Genji was promoted to Grand Minister, and the Right Captain was promoted to Minister of the Center.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣便将天下政务移交新内大臣掌管。

en.t: Grand Minister Genji then handed over the affairs of state to the new Minister of the Center to administer.

units.source_text: 这位新内大臣为人一向规矩正直，而且举止大方，心地贤明。

en.t: This new Minister of the Center had always been proper and upright, with generous manners and a wise heart.

units.source_text: 他富有学问，从前玩掩韵游戏时虽然比不上源氏，

en.t: He was rich in learning, and although in earlier days he had not matched Genji at the hidden-rhyme game,
he was extremely capable in handling public business.

units.source_text: 他有许多夫人，生了十几个儿子，都已渐次成人，各得官职，个个显赫，全家繁荣。

en.t: He had many wives and more than ten sons, who had gradually come of age, received official posts, and grown distinguished, so that the whole family prospered.

units.source_text: 女儿除弘徽殿女御以外，尚有一人，称为云居雁，年方十四，与弘徽殿女御异母。

en.t: Among his daughters, besides the Kokiden Consort, there was one other, called Kumoi no Kari, who was just fourteen and had a different mother from the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 其生母是亲王家女儿，娘家门第高贵，并不逊于弘徽殿女御之母。

en.t: Her birth mother was the daughter of a prince's family, and her maternal house was noble, in no way inferior to the mother of the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 但这生母后来改嫁了一位按察大纳言。

en.t: But this birth mother later remarried, becoming the wife of an Inspector Grand Counselor.

units.source_text: 这按察大纳言和她生了许多子女。

en.t: This Inspector Grand Counselor had many children with her.

units.source_text: 云居雁由母亲带去，杂在这许多子女中由后父抚养，内大臣认为有失体面，

en.t: Kumoi no Kari had been taken away by her mother and raised by her stepfather among all those children, which the Minister of the Center considered damaging to his dignity,

units.source_text: 便把云居雁接了回来，寄养在祖母太君膝下。

en.t: so he brought Kumoi no Kari back and placed her in the care of her grandmother, the Great Lady.

units.source_text: 内大臣对云居雁，远不如对弘徽殿女御之重视。

en.t: The Minister of the Center valued Kumoi no Kari far less than he valued the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 但云居雁的人品和相貌非常优美。

en.t: Yet Kumoi no Kari's character and appearance were exceptionally graceful and beautiful.
